name: httpx
notes: Ground truth = documentation changes between 0.27.2 and 0.28.1 that follow a code change and hold against the 0.28.1 code. Left out: '$ ' prompt prefixes, sponsor and third-party lists, the request.text typo, and the removal of SSL_CERT_FILE/SSL_CERT_DIR from the docs (0.28.1 still reads both when verify=True and trust_env).

items.anchor: If you'd like to use a custom CA bundle, you can use the `verify` parameter.
items.what: Passing a file path as verify="..." is deprecated (DeprecationWarning). A custom CA bundle is configured with verify=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=...) or capath=...

items.anchor: The `create_ssl_context` function accepts the same set of SSL configuration arguments
items.what: create_ssl_context() no longer accepts http2; its parameters are verify, cert and trust_env, and a verify path is deprecated there as well.
cert=... is deprecated. Client certificates are loaded with SSLContext.load_cert_chain() and the context is passed as verify=<context>.
The local HTTPS server example uses the deprecated verify=<path>; it should build an SSL context with cafile="client.pem" and pass it as verify.
HTTPX no longer reads SSLKEYLOGFILE; the variable is not supported any more.

items.anchor: When using a `Client` instance, the `trust_env`, `verify`, and `cert` arguments
items.what: cert is deprecated; SSL configuration (an SSL context passed as verify) belongs on the client instance, not on the request.
The proxy debugging example uses the deprecated verify=<path>; it should pass an SSL context created with cafile=...
The sample debug output shows load_ssl_context and load_verify_locations log lines that 0.28 no longer emits.
